A '''revolution''' took place on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phindar/Legends|Phindar]]<ref name="JA3" /> in [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]].<ref name="ERC" /> The [[Phindian/Legends|citizens of Phindar]] rose up against the ruling [[Syndicat]] and captured the Syndicat's leaders, including its head, [[Baftu]]. The citizens were aided in their efforts by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].<ref name="JA3" />
